title: Lior and the Oath
author: Zephyrine Eriksen
blurb: Casper Eriksen, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
